records.calculation: 100 × B08201_002E / B08201_001E. MOE = 100 × sqrt(M_num² + ratio² × M_den²) / denominator, a ratio approximation without covariance; retain raw values.
records.limitations: Not an unmet-demand or trust measure. Approximate MOE ignores numerator-denominator covariance; no MOE when either input unavailable. Zero denominator is unknown.

records.calculation: Simplify drive graph; convert to undirected multigraph to remove reciprocal edges; project EPSG:5070; clip each geometry; sum lengths / 1000.
records.limitations: Divided carriageways remain separate. Excludes non-drivable paths and private roads omitted by drive filter. Does not measure condition or completeness.

records.calculation: Sum clipped undirected segment lengths / number of positive-length clipped segments.
records.limitations: Boundary-clipped segments are shorter. Graph simplification and divided roads affect interpretation; not equivalent to block length.

records.calculation: Project graph to EPSG:5070; consolidate intersections with 10 m node buffers, rebuild_graph=False and dead_ends=False; count resulting centroids inside polygon / (AREALAND / 1e6).
records.limitations: Consolidation is geometric, not an operational intersection audit. Density has no universal readiness direction. Edge effects and land-area denominator affect comparisons.

records.calculation: 100 × clipped length carrying a sidewalk, sidewalk:left, sidewalk:right or sidewalk:both tag / clipped eligible length. Exclude motorway and motorway_link. All values including no count as documented.
records.limitations: Measures documentation only, not sidewalk presence, continuity, accessibility or quality. Mixed tag lists require all components documented; simplified segments with ambiguous coverage are excluded from numerator.
